tools.name: mta_get_arrivals
tools.description: Get upcoming train arrivals at a station. Accepts station ID or name (e.g., "127", "Times Square", "14th Street").

params.name: station_id
params.description: Station ID or name (e.g., "127", "Times Square", "Penn Station", "14th Street")

tools.name: mta_get_line_status
tools.description: Get current service status for a subway line

tools.name: mta_list_alerts
tools.description: List active service alerts across the subway system. By default only shows currently active alerts.

params.name: alert_type
params.description: Filter by type (Delays, Planned Work, etc.)

params.name: active_only
params.description: Only show currently active alerts (default: true). Set false to include future planned work.

tools.name: mta_search_stations
tools.description: Search for stations by name or line

tools.name: mta_get_station_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific station. Accepts station ID or name.

params.name: station_id
params.description: Station ID or name (e.g., "127", "Times Square", "Penn Station")

tools.name: mta_plan_trip
tools.description: Get route suggestions between two stations. Accepts station IDs or names.

params.name: origin_station_id
params.description: Starting station ID or name (e.g., "127", "Times Square", "Penn Station")

params.name: destination_station_id
params.description: Destination station ID or name (e.g., "R17", "Grand Central", "Union Square")

tools.name: bus_list_alerts
tools.description: Get active bus service alerts. Optionally filter by route or severity.

tools.name: bus_get_arrivals
tools.description: Get upcoming bus arrivals at a stop. Accepts stop ID or name (e.g., "402940", "5 Av/W 42 St").

params.name: stop_id
params.description: Stop ID or name (e.g., "402940", "5 Av/W 42 St", "Times Square")

tools.name: bus_get_route_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a bus route including type, boroughs served, and description.

tools.name: bus_search_stops
tools.description: Search bus stops by name, route, or borough. Use this to find stop IDs for bus_get_arrivals.

params.name: query
params.description: Search by stop name (e.g., "5 Av/W 42 St", "Times Square")

params.name: borough
params.description: Filter by borough (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island)

tools.name: ferry_get_arrivals
tools.description: Get upcoming ferry arrivals at a landing. Accepts landing ID or name (e.g., "PIER11", "Wall Street", "DUMBO").

params.name: route
params.description: Filter by route (e.g., "ER" for East River, "SB" for South Brooklyn)

tools.name: ferry_list_alerts
tools.description: Get active ferry service alerts. Optionally filter by route.

params.name: route
params.description: Filter by route (e.g., "ER" for East River, "RW" for Rockaway)

tools.name: ferry_search_landings
tools.description: Search ferry landings by name, route, or borough. Use this to find landing IDs for ferry_get_arrivals.

params.name: route
params.description: Filter by route (e.g., "ER" for East River, "SB" for South Brooklyn)

params.name: borough
params.description: Filter by borough (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island)

tools.name: ferry_get_routes
tools.description: List all NYC Ferry routes with their landings. Optionally get details for a specific route.

params.name: route
params.description: Get details for a specific route (e.g., "ER" for East River)

tools.name: bike_get_station_status
tools.description: Get bike and dock availability at a Citibike station. Accepts station ID or name (e.g., "Broadway & W 48 St", "E 40 St & Park Ave").

params.name: station_id
params.description: Station ID or name (e.g., "Broadway & W 48 St", "E 40 St & Park Ave")

tools.name: bike_search_stations
tools.description: Search for Citibike stations by name, borough, or availability. Returns station availability and capacity.

params.name: borough
params.description: Filter by borough (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx)

tools.name: bike_get_availability_summary
tools.description: Get an overview of Citibike availability by borough. Shows total bikes, docks, and station availability.

params.name: borough
params.description: Get summary for specific borough (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx). Omit for all boroughs.

tools.name: rail_get_departures
tools.description: Get upcoming LIRR or Metro-North departures at a station. Accepts station ID or name (e.g., "PENN", "Grand Central").

params.name: system
params.description: Filter by rail system (LIRR or MNR)

tools.name: rail_list_alerts
tools.description: Get active LIRR and Metro-North service alerts. Optionally filter by system, branch, or severity.

tools.name: rail_search_stations
tools.description: Search LIRR and Metro-North stations by name, system, or branch. Use this to find station IDs for rail_get_departures.

params.name: query
params.description: Search by station name (e.g., "Jamaica", "125th Street", "Grand Central")

tools.name: rail_get_station_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a LIRR or Metro-North station including accessibility, platforms, parking, and zone.

params.name: station_id
params.description: Station ID or name (e.g., "Jamaica", "125th Street", "Grand Central")

tools.name: transit_ask
tools.description: Ask natural language questions about NYC transit (subway, bus, ferry, rail, bike). Examples: "When is the next 1 train at Times Square?", "How do I get to JFK?", "Are there any Citibikes near Grand Central?"

params.name: location
params.description: Your current location for context (e.g., "Times Square", "40.758, -73.986")
